segments.normalizedSource: ```swift let text = "The ripe taste of cheese improves with age." let tagger = NLTagger(tagSchemes: [.lexicalClass]) tagger.string = text let options: NLTagger.Options = [.omitPunctuation, .omitWhitespace] tagger.enumerateTags(in: text.startIndex..<text.endIndex, unit: .word, scheme: .lexicalClass, options: options) { tag, tokenRange in if let tag = tag { print("\(text[tokenRange]): \(tag.rawValue)") } return true } ```
